revision: Explicit Canonical Retriever role after Evidence Parser clarification
document_title: Inside the GitHub Manager AI Pipeline

content_contract.existing_component: Canonical Retriever is descriptive documentation label for existing Python class Retriever, configured with method=tfidf by DemoService.
content_contract.retrieval_input: All retained repository evidence + active canonical concept documents, represented by name, description, aliases.
content_contract.retrieval_output: Ordered canonical Project/Topic/Tag IDs. These are possible label choices, not repositories, source passages, final assignments or probabilities.
content_contract.application_filtering: After per-kind caps, application removes protected/rejected/existing choices; model gets surviving id/kind/name/description objects without local scores/aliases.
content_contract.taxonomy: Taxonomy discovery does not use the Canonical Retriever; it proposes vocabulary from compact repository evidence.
content_contract.retained_parser: Evidence Parser builds E0 separately and E1+ README records in document order. Illustrative E1/Overview and E2/Features are not fixed section-to-ID assignments; several records may share a section and a retained heading itself may receive an ID.
content_contract.authority: Parsing, phrase extraction, label retrieval and compact selection are local; the LLM acts only after request preparation.
content_contract.composition: Five-stop taxonomy flow; four-stop classification flow with no RAKE-to-TF-IDF or request-to-answer bypass.
